reproduce.title: Isolate FancyZones virtual-desktop switching stalls
prerequisites: Windows 11 with two or more virtual desktops and FancyZones enabled.
setup: Prepare the same desktop-switch sequence with the Windows Settings window closed, then minimized on another desktop.
steps: Switch desktops repeatedly with Ctrl+Win+Left/Right while Settings is closed and record the delay.
Repeat with Settings open, then minimized on an unused desktop.
Repeat both states with FancyZones disabled as a control.
reproduce.expected_result: Desktop switching remains prompt with FancyZones enabled, independent of whether Settings is open or minimized.

comment.body: Thanks for the Settings-window workaround. Could you compare the same desktop-switch sequence with FancyZones enabled and disabled, first with Settings closed and then minimized, and report the approximate delays? This will show whether the workaround is timing-related or whether the slowdown follows FancyZones itself.
